hooks.name: adop-inject-run-context
hooks.description: Injects in-flight run state at session start so a resumed or compacted orchestrator recovers from disk instead of re-asking the human. Read-only, never blocks. NOTE: SessionStart was not observed firing during testing on Kiro IDE -- verify before relying on it.

hooks.name: adop-block-credentials
hooks.description: Denies writes containing hardcoded credentials or infrastructure identifiers.

hooks.name: adop-enforce-template-codegen
hooks.description: Denies hand-written pipeline artifacts under workloads/*/scripts/; those are rendered from schema-validated specs only.

hooks.name: adop-validate-artifacts
hooks.description: ENFORCING. Syntax errors and credentials in a pending artifact are denied before the write. Every check runs on the payload content, so it does not need the file on disk.

hooks.name: adop-validate-artifacts-post
hooks.description: ADVISORY. Second pass on the file as written, covering content that reached disk by a route with no tool_input (a bash heredoc, say). Kiro's PostToolUse cannot block, so findings are reported only.
